title: Machine learning-guided screening finds four micromolar E. coli MurB inhibitors
summary: Five machine learning models built with AutoMolDesigner (RDKit_2D-based Model_2 selected) screened an in-house library, giving 238 compounds that were docked, and 16 candidates were tested. Four compounds (Q9, Q11, Q12, Q13) inhibited MurB more than 50% at 50 uM, with IC50 values of 25.08-34.44 uM, and showed low cytotoxicity in HepG2 cells in a preliminary assay. Potency is only micromolar. First online publication 2026-11-01.
ai_technology: Machine learning activity models (AutoMolDesigner, RDKit_2D-based Model_2) for virtual screening of an in-house compound library

evidence.tested: Enzyme inhibition assays at 50 uM and IC50 determination for candidate compounds; HepG2 cytotoxicity assay.
evidence.unknown: Antibacterial activity, selectivity and optimization potential are not stated; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning models prioritized compounds from a library for docking and enzyme assays.

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
